tools.name: invoicemaven_search_documents
tools.description: Read a page of existing Invoice Maven documents. Maximum 20 per page. This POST is a search and never creates, issues or cancels fiscal documents.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: invoicemaven_search_documents · Private data: invoicemaven_search_documents · Public sink: invoicemaven_search_documents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: invoicemaven_search_documents · Private data: invoicemaven_search_documents · Public sink: invoicemaven_search_documents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
